editorial:
Frank Martin is back behind the wheel, and this time the job is personal in all the wrong ways. You follow him as he escorts Valentina, a kidnapped Ukrainian official's daughter, across Europe from Marseilles to Odessa. The route is packed with car chases, fistfights, and shady enemies who want to stop the delivery. The movie keeps things moving with a mix of slick driving, tough-guy attitude, and a little romance that never gets too heavy. It is not deep, but it knows exactly what kind of ride it wants to be.

The action is the main draw, with clean fight scenes and plenty of car stunts that feel fun rather than exhausting. Jason Statham brings his usual cool, no-nonsense energy, while Natalya Rudakova adds charm and trouble as Valentina. Some jokes land better than others, and the plot is simple, but the pacing rarely drags. If you want a loud, easy action movie for a weekend night, this is a good pick. Stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray.
endingExplained: In the final stretch, Frank reaches Odessa and faces the men behind the kidnapping. Valentina's father is being pressured over a toxic waste deal, and the villains want her used as leverage. Frank fights through the last wave of thugs, protects Valentina, and stops the plan from working. The movie ends with Frank completing the delivery and walking away from the chaos, keeping his cool while Valentina is safe. It is a straightforward finish with no big twist, just a clean win for the hero.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves car chases and no-nonsense action heroes.
